title: From Reddit to Generative AI: Evaluating Large Language Models for Anxiety Support Fine-tuned on Social Media Data

bias_targets.methodology: Quantified using the Average Bias Conditional Absolute Score (ABCAS) derived from GenBit, which measures diversity and repetition in language use.
Evaluated using in-context impersonation by introducing identity-specific variations in prompts to uncover disparities in model behavior.
